candidateOccurrences.sourceText: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty-two cities with their villages.
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: The border turned to Ramah, to the fortified city of Tyre; and the border turned to Hosah. It ended at the sea by the region of Achzib;
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.
